description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Mirror Image until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mirror Image from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Fiend Hunter.
Mirror Image enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Mirror Image
uses.cardState: as a copy of Fiend Hunter
